name: dm32uv-re patch kit
_note: Attaches to the docker/docker-compose.yml service 'dm32uv-re' (same container 'docker compose run --rm dm32uv-re' uses). The Dockerfile ENTRYPOINT is /bin/bash with no long-running command, so overrideCommand:true makes the devcontainer start it with `sleep infinity` to keep the session alive; shutdownAction:stopCompose tears the compose project down with the devcontainer. The compose file bind-mounts repo subdirectories (tools/, meta/, data/, src/, include/, out/) under /work but NOT the repo root, so workspaceFolder is /work and only those directories are visible/editable inside the container (edit docs/, docker/, .github/ etc. on the host, or add a volume). The git submodule postCreateCommand is best-effort: the vendor/ submodules are baked into the image at build time and the repo root (.git) is not mounted, so it may report 'not a git repository' - harmless; run submodule updates from the host repo root instead.
